question: What is the direction of the southeast trade winds in India during the southwest monsoon season?
solution:
The correct answer is __**South-westerly.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **South-westerly:-**

 
 
• The direction of the southeast trade winds in India during the southwest monsoon season is South-westerly.
 
• The southwest monsoon season in India generally lasts from June to September.
 
• The southeast trade winds blow towards the equator and are deflected westwards due to the Coriolis effect.
